lines.text: Therefore, to th' war!
lines.plainText: Therefore to th' war

lines.text: It shall be so; I'll send her to my house,
lines.plainText: It shall be so I'll send her to my house

lines.text: Acquaint my mother with my hate to her,
lines.plainText: Acquaint my mother with my hate to her

lines.text: And wherefore I am fled; write to the king
lines.plainText: And wherefore I am fled write to the king

lines.text: That which I durst not speak. His present gift
lines.plainText: That which I durst not speak His present gift

lines.text: Shall furnish me to those Italian fields
lines.plainText: Shall furnish me to those Italian fields

lines.text: Where noble fellows strike. War is no strife
lines.plainText: Where noble fellows strike War is no strife

lines.text: To the dark house and the detested wife.
lines.plainText: To the dark house and the detested wife

lines.text: Will this caprichio hold in thee, art sure?
lines.plainText: Will this caprichio hold in thee art sure

lines.text: Go with me to my chamber and advise me.
lines.plainText: Go with me to my chamber and advise me

lines.text: I'll send her straight away. Tomorrow

lines.text: I'll to the wars, she to her single sorrow.

lines.text: Why, these balls bound; there's noise in it. 'Tis hard:

lines.text: A young man married is a man that's marr'd.

lines.text: Therefore away, and leave her bravely; go.
